title: Share MSBuild copy-local metadata and optional property presence semantics
outcome: Share MSBuild copy-local metadata and optional property presence semantics
acceptance: Add decisive pre-fix RED and post-fix GREEN regressions, cold/delta and caller coverage proportional to stored-output changes, version/schema/capability discipline without changed limits, full quality gates and dual independent review.

An absent optional property in an early PropertyGroup nonempty guard can skip the group without inventing a value; distinguish explicit incomplete/unknown authority and preserve set-value behavior, with generic shared rules rather than a property-name exception.

ProjectReference Private true/false does not remove compiler references or cause F# metadata refusal; shared reference metadata policy is exercised through actual C# and F# callers with ReferenceOutputAssembly controls.
